script.name: kitchen
script.text: a one-cook kitchen: onions into the pot, cook, plate and serve each order

clauses.name: fetch_onion
clauses.doc: walk to a dispenser and take an onion.

clauses.name: load
clauses.doc: drop the onion into pot capacity.

clauses.name: cook
clauses.doc: three onions start the cook — needs a free hand to press start (the env's interact semantics; also forces cook-before-dish).

clauses.name: fetch_dish
clauses.doc: fetch a dish while the soup cooks.

clauses.name: plate
clauses.doc: cooked soup onto the held dish.

script.name: kitchen_shared
script.text: a shared kitchen: a second cook also loads onions into the pot

clauses.name: partner_load
clauses.doc: the second cook drops an onion into the first cook's pot.

kitchen.text:
kitchen [served] "a one-cook kitchen: onions into the pot, cook, plate and serve each order"
  fetch_onion: walk to a dispenser and take an onion. [hand_free -o held_onion]
  load: drop the onion into pot capacity. [held_onion * pot_space -o hand_free * pot_onion]
  cook: three onions start the cook — needs a free hand to press start (the env's interact semantics; also forces cook-before-dish). [$hand_free * pot_onion^3 -o cooking]
  fetch_dish: fetch a dish while the soup cooks. [hand_free -o held_dish]
  plate: cooked soup onto the held dish. [held_dish * cooking -o held_soup]
  serve: deliver. [held_soup -o hand_free * served]
  atoms: hand_free = a free hand, held_onion = an onion in hand, held_dish = a dish in hand, held_soup = a soup in hand, pot_space = room in the pot, pot_onion = onions in the pot, cooking = a soup cooking, ready = a soup ready, served = soups served
kitchen_shared [sibling] "a shared kitchen: a second cook also loads onions into the pot"
  partner_load → kitchen: the second cook drops an onion into the first cook's pot. [pot_space -o pot_onion]
  atoms: pot_space = room in the pot, pot_onion = onions in the pot
